note: Pinned build inputs: exact versions, except cmake which carries a minimum floor. Verify with: pixi install && tools/build --check-toolchain. The pixi.lock file carries authoritative conda package hashes; this file records the selected versions and their provenance.

libbpf_source.note: Consumed through the libbpf-mojo bridge; MemVeil never links libbpf directly.

cmake.role: native build driver; default install in each environment

python.role: development validation only; never runtime collection or replay

product_contracts.note: External record contracts live in schemas/; native bridge ABI is owned by libbpf-mojo.

libbpf-mojo.note: Pre-release bytes built from clean 59d5451 (first-release version 0.1.0; abi-v1 unchanged); not yet tagged, so re-pin from the tagged release before any distribution claim. Consumed by path (LMB_PACKAGE) plus this hash. Memveil never reads libbpf-mojo sibling sources; standalone clones supply the tarball.

platform_floor.kernel: >= 7.0 for collection; doctor, help, version, and offline report have no kernel floor
platform_floor.note: A version string is eligibility only. Each capability needs its own profile and live evidence.

decisions: D1: pixi (pixi.toml + pixi.lock) is the Mojo project manifest; one manifest per repository.
D2: Mojo 1.1.0 stable from the public max channel; nightly builds are not used.
D3: libbpf is consumed only through the pinned libbpf-mojo bridge, never linked directly.
D4: System clang 21.1.8 pinned by exact version string for C eBPF compilation. Revisit on BPF codegen issues.
D5: Validation tooling uses Python standard library only; no third-party Python dependencies.
D6: External schema version 0.1.0 is independent of product, bridge ABI, and BPF wire versions.
D7: cmake is a build driver, not a codegen input: the check enforces a minimum version (default install per environment), not an exact pin. Tools that affect output bits stay exact.
